plans.name: Our 8-hour weeks · four at $600
plans.notes: Director guidance: one combined income target for both owners; at most 8 hours/week each. A 30-day model uses 4.4 workweeks, so 35.2 hours each is a modeled ceiling, not a calendar schedule. Placeholder: reserve 6 sales/admin hours each per period. Owner nonproject hours are entered directly; partner delivery availability is 35.2 minus 6 = 29.2 hours before the 10% buffer. Partner hourly cash cost is 0 because both owners draw from the combined remainder, not because partner work has no value. Combined income target is $2,000, confirmed by the director and editable. The older frozen baseline intentionally retains the earlier unknown target. Retained amount $400 and all service prices, costs and effort are editable fictional placeholders. Four jobs require owner20 hours and partner30 hours INCLUDING admin, 50 actual combined hours; the app counted-work total excludes partner admin and shows44. Two setups in every alternative. No demand or payment collection is confirmed.
